xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4589: CI test gate: recognize commit-status CI (Dagger Cloud checks)

plan.title: CI test gate: recognize commit-status CI (Dagger Cloud checks)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Every CI test-job classifier calls isCiTestCheckName(check.name). GitHub commit statuses (StatusContext rows) have no name, so commit-status CI such as Dagger Cloud checks is invisible: a Dagger-only project shows testChecks 'none' and testJobSucceeded false forever, the merge gate and auto-merge never see a passed test job, the default-branch baseline is no-tests, a green Dagger test status never resets the attempt streak or lifts the stuck pause, feedback carries no link, and toChecksState shows a Dagger-red PR green.
narratives.Proposal: Add isDaggerCloudUrl / isDaggerCloudTestCheck / isCiTestRollupCheck beside isCiTestCheckName (unchanged). pr-facts classifies rollup rows with isCiTestRollupCheck and carries a status's targetUrl on FailedCheck. The default-branch baseline also reads each commit's paginated combined status. handleStatus records the CI test pass on a green test status. CI test-gate feedback lists failing status test checks with their link and the `dagger check dag://<context>` rerun command. toChecksState honors state. Mode detection stays workflow-only; dagger.toml only adds a hint to the local reason. Docs gain a Dagger Cloud subsection.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Auto-detecting verification.tests: ci from dagger.toml or live commit statuses (the mode stays local unless set explicitly)
- Changing isCiTestCheckName or how GitHub Actions check runs classify
- Recognizing segment-matched contexts on non-dagger.cloud statuses (a Buildkite go-client/test stays unrecognized)
- GitLab external statuses or pipelines
- Fetching Dagger Cloud logs into the feedback file
- Feedback links for non-test failing statuses or for projects not in verification.tests: ci
- Changes to dod-gate.ts or summarizeStatusCheckRollup
- Raising any file-size allowlist cap or extracting pr-facts.ts
- New HTTP routes
- Editing the OKF knowledge bundle repo

autoDecisions.rationale: One classifier module already imported by every consumer (pr-facts, ci-default-branch-tests, webhook-handlers, ci-failure-feedback); no new import edges.

autoDecisions.summary: Dagger host rule is https plus hostname dagger.cloud or *.dagger.cloud; malformed URL is false
autoDecisions.rationale: Subdomains are Dagger-controlled; repo writers can post any status URL anyway, so this is classification, not a trust boundary.

autoDecisions.summary: Rollup classifier is isCiTestCheckName(name ?? context) || isDaggerCloudTestCheck(context, targetUrl)
autoDecisions.rationale: Issue scope 1 mandates name ?? context; this recognizes Buildkite/Jenkins statuses named 'test' while the segment rule stays dagger.cloud-only so a non-Dagger go-client/test is not recognized (issue AC).

autoDecisions.summary: Commit status 'error' counts as a failing test check
autoDecisions.rationale: pr-facts already treats StatusContext ERROR as failed and the relay counts ERROR; the baseline maps error to failure so PR and baseline names line up.
dagger/dagger posts 90 statuses per commit; a 100-row page would soon drop test statuses and mislabel inherited failures as the PR's.

autoDecisions.summary: Include the status-webhook pass path and the toChecksState state fix although the issue did not list them
autoDecisions.rationale: Without the pass path a Dagger project's stuck pause never lifts (PIPELINE-GATES promises it does); without the toChecksState fix the board shows Dagger-red PRs green and the scheduler enqueues them. Both are small direct consequences of the same blindness.
Verified: checksOutcome never calls isCiTestCheckName and already reads conclusion ?? state ?? status; the issue's mention is inaccurate.

autoDecisions.summary: pr-facts.ts stays under the 1000-line ceiling through call-site swaps, no extraction
autoDecisions.rationale: File is at 993 lines; the swaps plus one closure and one field net about +3 lines, which is cheaper and lower-risk than an extraction refactor.

autoDecisions.summary: FailedCheck.targetUrl comes only from StatusContext targetUrl, never from check-run detailsUrl
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps existing toEqual expectations on listFailedTestChecks valid (NFR-1).
